# Phylogenetics Tree Metrics

Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

## Input And Metric

- Branch-length sums, patristic distances, and long-branch metrics require
  phylogenetic trees with the relevant branch lengths and rooting assumptions.
- Informative-site, composition-variability, alignment-length, and gap metrics
  require multiple sequence alignments. A FASTA suffix alone does not prove the
  sequences are aligned.
- Sequence distance, patristic distance, total tree length, and evolutionary
  rate are different quantities. Use the requested definition and denominator.

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, statistics
exe='/opt/agent-venv/bin/pk_total_tree_length'
for group in ('animals','fungi'):
    paths=sorted(Path(f'work/scogs_{group}').glob('*.treefile'))
    vals=[]
    failed=[]
    for p in paths:
        cp=subprocess.run([exe,str(p)],text=True,capture_output=True)
        try:
            vals.append(float(cp.stdout.strip()))
        except Exception:
            failed.append((p.name,cp.returncode,cp.stdout,cp.stderr))
    print(group, 'selected',len(paths),'processed',len(vals),'failed',len(failed))
    print('min',min(vals),'median',statistics.median(vals),'max',max(vals))
    print('middle', sorted(vals)[(len(vals)-1)//2:(len(vals)//2)+1])
    if failed: print(failed[:3])
    globals()[group]=vals
ma=statistics.median(animals); mf=statistics.median(fungi)
print('fungi/animals',mf/ma)
print('animals/fungi',ma/mf)
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from Bio import Phylo
from statistics import median
import subprocess
exe='/opt/agent-venv/bin/pk_total_tree_length'
for group in ('animals','fungi'):
    rows=[]
    for p in sorted(Path(f'work/scogs_{group}').glob('*.treefile')):
        t=Phylo.read(p,'newick')
        raw=sum((c.branch_length or 0.0) for c in t.find_clades())
        shown=float(subprocess.check_output([exe,str(p)],text=True).strip())
        rows.append((raw,shown,p.name,len(t.get_terminals())))
    s=sorted(rows)
    print(group,'taxon_counts',sorted(set(x[3] for x in rows)))
    print('raw_median',median(x[0] for x in rows),'display_median',median(x[1] for x in rows))
    for x in s[(len(s)-1)//2:(len(s)//2)+1]: print('central',x)
    print('max_abs_rounding_delta',max(abs(x[0]-x[1]) for x in rows))
    globals()[group]=rows
raw_ratio=median(x[0] for x in fungi)/median(x[0] for x in animals)
display_ratio=median(x[1] for x in fungi)/median(x[1] for x in animals)
print('raw_fungi_over_animals',format(raw_ratio,'.15g'))
print('display_fungi_over_animals',format(display_ratio,'.15g'))
print('rounded_2dp',format(display_ratio,'.2f'))
PY
sed -n '1p' work/scogs_animals/*.treefile | head -n 3
sed -n '1p' work/scogs_fungi/*.treefile | head -n 3"
